title: fix(app-shell): the approval request's "As submitted" summary draws the submitted file fields, and each file opens
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoShPRwR7m6qzdXdZvptvrJg)_

Fixes #32854

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:审批申请页「提交时的内容」现在会画出提交时的附件字段(`file` 单个与多个、`image`、`avatar`、`video`、`audio`),每个文件是可点开的链接,图片是可点开的缩略图;其余对象/列表型字段(地址、位置、json、多选、多值引用等)按一条写明的规则继续不画。
- **为什么改**:原来所有对象或数组值一律跳过,报销单的「电子发票」(多文件字段)在审批页看不到,审批人看不到自己要批的发票。
- **风险与回滚**:只改前端一个摘要组件,不改服务端、不加下载通道(链接走平台已有的 `/api/v1/storage/files/ID`,权限由该端点自己判);附件行不占 6 行上限。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`snapshotSummaryPlan.ts`(附件分支在对象跳过之前)、`RecordSnapshotSummary.tsx`(头注释里的规则与附件区块)、`RecordSnapshotSummary.test.tsx`(新增 pin)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/RecordSnapshotSummary.test.tsx`,预期 36/36 通过;或打开一张带电子发票的报销审批,「提交时的内容」下方出现「电子发票」及每个文件的链接。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。
- **席位意见**:席位(domain:ui#4)审过。附件类字段(文件、图片、头像、音视频)用记录页同一个字段单元格画出,打开走平台已有的下载接口,由接口判权限,没有新增下载通道;不占 6 行上限。其它对象或列表值按 PR 写明的规则不画,审批人点开记录可看全。只改审批页摘要,不碰服务端,没有新增文案键。CI 全绿后按队列落地。

## What changes

`planSnapshotSummary` gains an `attachments` list. A declared field whose type is in the spec's media family `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` (imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`, not copied) is routed there before the object/list skip, when it holds a file. `RecordSnapshotSummary` draws those fields full width after the business rows, under the same "As submitted" heading, each through the field's own cell (`getCellRenderer`, the record page's face): `FileCellRenderer` for `file` / `video` / `audio`, `ImageCellRenderer` for `image` / `avatar`. No new widget, no new download channel, no server change; `ui/packages/fields/**` is read only.

### The rule: object and list values, kind by kind

| Kind | Drawn? | How / why |
|---|---|---|
| `file`, `multiple: true` | drawn | one link per file, each opening the platform download endpoint (`FileValueAffordance`, `target=_blank`) |
| `file`, single | drawn | one link that opens the file; a stored bare id already passed the old skip as a grid row, it now moves to the attachment block |
| `image`, `avatar` | drawn | thumbnail from the download endpoint; a click opens the image lightbox (the record page's cell) |
| `video`, `audio` | drawn | same link face as `file` (the registry maps them to `FileCellRenderer`) |
| any of the above, empty (`null`, blank id, empty list, empty object) | left out | nothing was submitted; the scalar rule's "empty gets no row" applied to attachments |
| `address`, `location` / `geolocation` | left out | a multi-line block or a map; a one-line glance row would cut it |
| `json` / `object`, `composite`, `record`, `repeater`, `grid`, `vector` | left out | structured faces (key lists, tables) that a glance row cannot hold |
| `multiselect`, `checkboxes`, `tags` (list values) | left out | a chip list a truncated row would cut; the record shows it whole |
| multi-value reference (`lookup` / `user` with `multiple`) | left out | a list of record ids, a chip list a truncated row would cut; the record shows it whole |
| any other object or list value | left out | the rule is by value shape: only the media family is drawn |

**Row cap:** attachments are not counted against `SNAPSHOT_SUMMARY_ROWS` (6) and are never cut by it, because the attachment is what the approver decides on. The lead and the six business rows are chosen exactly as before. Every existing filter still applies first: undeclared keys, `hidden: true`, framework-managed columns, and fields the reader may not read (`withoutDeniedFields`) get no attachment row.

**What the snapshot holds (measured):** the approvals service stores the flow's `$record` (the engine's write result, file fields in stored form, the bare `sys_file` id) and serves it redacted per reader, with no file expansion. `readFileValue` turns a bare id into `/api/v1/storage/files/ID`, the stable endpoint that judges access and redirects to a signed URL, and reads the expanded `{ id, name, url }` and refused `{ id, metadataRefused }` forms too. So the value carries what opening needs; no server change.

## Why

The plan skipped every object or array value (`value == null || typeof value === 'object'`), and a multi-file field's value is an array, so the e-invoices field never showed on the approval page while the same claim's own page showed both files.

## Tests

`RecordSnapshotSummary.test.tsx`, new blocks `planSnapshotSummary: object and list values (objectstack#32854)` and `RecordSnapshotSummary: attachments are drawn and open (objectstack#32854)`:

- `multiple` file: each file drawn as a link with the download href and `target=_blank`, after the five business rows, outside a cap of 2 in the plan pin, never the lead.
- single file (stored id and expanded form), `image`, `avatar`, `video`, `audio`: one pin each (plan + render).
- CONTROL: address, location, json, multiselect and a multi-value lookup stay out (plan and render), and the scalar rows are unchanged.
- CONTROL: empty, hidden and undeclared attachment fields take no row.
- The eight existing plan assertions gained `attachments: []`; their rows, lead and summed values are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablation (on-disk proof via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, restored blob equals HEAD): restoring the object skip ahead of the attachment arm turns 8 pins red, every multi-file, expanded-object and list-valued attachment pin; the string-id pins stay green because a bare-id string already passed the old skip as a scalar row.
- The surface grep for `ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔` hits the summary header's name-guess ban and the two #27502 ruling records (the "As submitted" heading); attachments sit under that same heading, so both hold.
- No i18n key added (labels are the declared field labels; the file name fallback is the cell's existing `fields.file.fileFallback`), so Clause-② stays `no`.

## Verification

Head `499a94e2` (one `origin/main` merge before opening; nothing merged touches this surface or its dependencies' sources).

- Every test that imports the changed modules (6 app-shell files + the console's `servedPageSummary-12483` and `servedPageSummaryAmount-12534`): 8 files, 105/105 passed before the merge; the 6 app-shell files 81/81 after it.
